mcu.unused_usb_socket: must remain unused once the external USB port is connected
mcu.mount: Two fixed right corner channels plus removable left C-cap/M2x8 screw;slide module5 mm from left before fitting cap;no adhesive required for MCU retention.

left_cap.screw: M2x8,head≤4.0 mm diameter and≤1.5 mm high
left_cap.bare_contact_note: Cap spine stays outside PCB;two fingers contact audited left corners,leaving RGB/BOOT/RESET completely clear.

screws.note: M2x6 gives4.4 mm nominal plastic thread engagement and0.6 mm blind-tip clearance;gentle machine-screw self-tapping,do not overtighten.

usb.dimensions_status: PCB outline/face/mounting holes from native manufacturer Eagle;PCB thickness and socket centre height are fit allowances to check on purchased part.

wire_contract.usb_pair: Keep D+/D− adjacent as short twisted pairs:breakout→main upstream ESD→BQ24392 pins7/8; separate downstream nets pins3/2→MCU TP4/TP12; never bypass or bridge the USB isolation switch.
wire_contract.routing_note: Fan wires in a flat layer below stock PCBs;gather slack only in left reservation,not between support ledges and bare PCB edges.
wire_contract.strain_relief: Tie small loom to printed lid anchor;after tests,tack wires to main soldermask away from pads/components with a small removable electronics-safe adhesive bead so lid movement cannot peel surface pads.

physical_validation_required: Check purchased MCU/USB board outlines and thickness with calipers.
Check complete seven-module fit without forcing leads.
Check soldered-wire and screw-head heights within allowances.
Trial-print empty case,slide channels and actual USB plug fit.
Inspect all internal wires and USB insertion load transfer before power.

Print closure coupon and empty case; verify all four detents seat positively, resist cable insertion/removal loads and reopen at the notch without cracking. Repeat several cycles before fitting electronics.

main_solder_pads.note: Pre-tin ends and pads;provide a gentle loop and mechanical/adhesive strain relief away from the surface pads.

bc12.good_bat: Hard-tied always-on +3V3, not switched driver supply
bc12.full_current_rule: BC_DET HIGH and BC_AL_N LOW stable100ms; USB host suspend still overrides

case_closure.type: Four rounded bead-and-pocket snap detents on long edges; removable using existing top pry notch
case_closure.intentional_interference: At intermediate closing/opening positions, the beads overlap the undeflected shell by at most0.20mm; the shell must flex. Fully seated beads occupy matching pockets without nominal solid overlap.
case_closure.placement_note: Bottom right detent is atx87 rather thanx74 to avoid the USB plug well; every bead is above the USB/MCU upper envelopes.
case_closure.coupon: case-closure-fit-coupon.stl:two separate pieces printed together; representative bead/pocket clearances only, not a full-case retention-force prediction.
case_closure.validation: Unprinted prototype. Check seating, retention under cable insertion/removal, hand opening at notch and repeated cycles with chosen material; PLA/PETG stiffness and shrinkage differ. Do not claim measured force or elastic lifetime.
